extension.description: Generate safe, structured Conventional Commit messages from staged Git changes using the local Codex CLI.
command.generate.title: Generate Commit Message
command.regenerate.title: Regenerate Commit Message
command.checkEnvironment.title: Check Codex Environment
capability.untrusted: Codex Commit Safe executes Git and the local Codex CLI and reads staged workspace content, so a trusted workspace is required.
capability.virtual: Codex Commit Safe requires a local Git repository and local CLI executables.
config.codexPath: Codex CLI executable path. Application-scoped: only User Settings can configure it.
config.model: Optional Codex model. Application-scoped: only User Settings can configure it.
config.language: Language used for the generated commit description and body.
config.maxDiffBytes: Maximum staged diff size sent to Codex, in bytes.
config.subjectMaxLength: Preferred maximum length of the commit subject line.
config.maxBodyChars: Maximum accepted character count for the generated commit message.
config.autoInferScope: Infer a preferred scope from staged paths and changed-code semantics; generic paths, weak evidence, or conflicting signals do not force a scope.
config.extraInstructions: Team-specific instructions appended to the generation prompt. Workspace/project values are treated as untrusted prompt data.
config.timeoutSeconds: Maximum time to wait for Codex CLI.
config.scopeHints: Optional mapping from configured scopes to semantic aliases used only by local scope inference. Hints are static text and are never executed.
config.scopePolicy: Controls whether generated non-empty scopes may go beyond the configured scopes.
config.scopePolicy.flexible: Flexible: configured scopes are preferred, but Codex may return another accurate scope.
config.scopePolicy.strict: Strict: scope must be empty or one of the configured scopes.
